_doc: GENERIC graded return-to-climbing protocols. Not medical advice. A diagnosis by a physiotherapist or physician always overrides these stages. Advance one stage only when pain is <= 2/10 during and not worse next morning (pain-monitoring model).
disclaimer: These are generic, educational progressions and not a diagnosis or treatment plan. If you have an audible pop, bowstringing, swelling, pain at rest above 3/10 or no improvement after 2 weeks, stop climbing and see a physiotherapist or sports physician.

stages.title: Protect & move
content: Daily tendon glides and pain-free range of motion
No climbing or hangboarding with the injured finger
Rest of training: legs, core, antagonists

stages.title: Low-load isometrics
content: No-hang / loading pin, open hand, 20-30 % of healthy-hand peak, 6 x 30 s
Progress 5 % per session if pain <= 2/10
Tape (H-tape) as advised by your physio

stages.title: Easy climbing, open hand
content: Jugs and big open-hand holds only, vertical terrain
Isometrics progress to 50-60 %
No crimping, no pockets on the injured finger

stages.title: Progressive grips
content: Half crimp reintroduced on large edges
Board/steep climbing at moderate grades
Hangboard back to ~70 % of pre-injury loads

stages.title: Return to full training
content: Max hangs from ~85 % of pre-injury loads
Full crimp and 2-finger pockets last, low volume

stages.title: Calm down
content: Reduce aggravating volume (pull-ups, steep board)
Isometric wrist flexion/extension holds 5 x 45 s, pain <= 3/10

stages.title: Isotonic loading
content: Slow wrist curls/extensions 3 x 15, 3 x per week
Climbing allowed under the pain-monitoring rules

stages.title: Heavy slow resistance
content: Heavier wrist work 4 x 8
Reintroduce pulling and board climbing progressively

stages.title: Settle
content: Avoid painful ranges (wide gastons, deep lock-offs)
Scapular setting, band external rotations 3 x 15

stages.title: Rebuild
content: Progressive rotator-cuff and scapular strength
Vertical climbing, controlled moves

stages.title: Return
content: Steep climbing and dynamic moves reintroduced
Pull-ups and lock-offs back to prior loads
